detail.title: Advancing Memory-Based Preference Research
detail.summary: This proposal initiates further research into path-dependent memory accumulation in autonomous agents within the Memory-Based Preference Emergence project, while adhering to current capability constraints.

children.title: path dependency experiential memory reinforcement learning emergent behavioral biases

detail.reason: Deepening the empirical grounding of how autonomous agents develop stable preferences through historical data accumulation and reinforcement learning dynamics.
